result.title: WASP-Mem: Let Agent Organize Procedural Memory. Human Spend Effort on Diagnosis
result.comment: 24 pages (10 main + references and appendix), 6 figures, 14 tables. Peizhi Niu and Ge Shi contributed equally
result.summary: LLM agents struggle to automate complex enterprise procedures because static, pre-built harness cannot capture proprietary policies, undocumented behaviors, or state-dependent recovery paths that surface only during execution. Procedural memory accrued from agent experience offers a training-free path to closing this gap -- yet unlike episodic records or semantic facts, it must consolidate repeated successes and diagnosed failures into reusable actions and recovery strategies. We introduce WASP-Mem (Wiki-based Agent-Synthesized Procedural Memory), a nimble but effective method that distills execution traces and feedback into persistent, interlinked wiki pages, enabling continual agent learning. On TheAgentCompany benchmark, WASP-Mem raises the checkpoint pass rate by 4.6-6.1% over the strongest baseline we compared across three models while requiring 57-61% less storage. We further present a systematic controlled study spanning consolidation method, feedback type, trace ingestion scope, and refinement rounds. Our results reveal that prescriptive knowledge organization such as human defined schemas and explicit deduplication rules hurts performance rather than closing the procedural-knowledge gap. In contrast, human diagnosis converts failed traces into corrective knowledge and drives sustained improvement: a single round of human diagnosis outperforms four rounds of self-judgment by 7.0-10.9%. These findings point to a simple division of labor: let agents organize procedural memory, and invest human effort where it matters most -- diagnosis.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 WASP-Mem，将 agent 的执行轨迹与反馈蒸馏成互链的 wiki 页面作为可持久化的程序性记忆，使 agent 无需训练即可持续积累可复用动作与恢复策略，并在 TheAgentCompany 上做了记忆整合方式、反馈类型、轨迹摄取范围与精炼轮数的控制实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「失败轨迹经人类诊断转为纠正性知识、显式 schema 与去重规则反而有害」的发现，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督、失败反馈的贡献分配与记忆组织方式提供可供核查的类比线索，但工作本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态。
